label: Tuya Telemetry Bridges
info: Bridges Tuya plug DPS values to MQTT topics. Subscribed by HW v3+ dispatcher (plug_state/power) and AC v1 dispatcher (state/power/temps). Adding/changing nodes here doesn't affect the dispatch tabs directly — they read via MQTT.

label: Data Persistence
info: JSONL event log + state snapshots on /data/bsf/. HTTP endpoints at /api/bsf/* reachable via Victron cloud relay. Schema at ~/Documents/wikis/bsf/data/SCHEMA.md.

label: AC v1.5 (morning warm-up)
info: AC v1.5 — single-window MORNING dispatcher (04:30-08:00). SOC ≥ 75 % → AC ON, sustained 60 s. Outside MORNING → 5-min force-OFF loop. Skips temps (Tuya plug telemetry not flowing). Plug command wired to bridge.tuya.ac in the Tuya Telemetry Bridges tab.

name: Hot Water (solar window + 90/95%)
v3+ Phase 1 — PLUG COMMAND UNWIRED
info:
This tab is Phase 1 of the v3+ rollout.

The dispatcher's plug-command output (out[0]) and the lockout-loop's plug-command output (out[0]) are intentionally left disconnected.

That means: deploying this tab WILL NOT toggle the hot-water plug. The existing 'SOC Load Shedding' tab keeps doing that.

What to verify before Phase 2:
  1. Subscribe to bsf/hotwater/status — should publish every 30 s with realistic numbers (surplus, SOC, AC load, mode).
  2. bsf/hotwater/log should show a 'sunrise_cron' entry after the daily 02:00 inject fires (or trigger it manually once to seed flow.sunrise/flow.sunset).
  3. No noisy error spam in the debug pane.

Phase 2 (do by hand):
  • Wire dispatcher out[0] → existing tuya-smart-device 'Hot Water' node.
  • Wire lockout out[0] → same tuya node.
  • In 'SOC Load Shedding' tab: delete the wire from hw-fn out[1] to hot-water-tuya. Keep hw-fn itself (one-click rollback).
  • Deploy.

info:
Phase 2 step (do by hand, then Deploy):

1. Drag a wire from dispatcher.out[0] across to the tuya-smart-device 'Hot Water' node in the 'SOC Load Shedding' tab.
2. Drag a wire from lockout.out[0] to the same tuya-smart-device node.
3. In 'SOC Load Shedding' tab: delete the wire from hw-fn.out[0] (plug-cmd output) to hot-water-tuya. Leave hw-fn itself in place — that's your one-click rollback.
4. Click Deploy (modified flows only).
5. Watch VRM + bsf/hotwater/status for 30 min.

name: event handler
func: const ev={ts:(msg.payload&&msg.payload.ts)||new Date().toISOString(),topic:msg.topic||'',payload:msg.payload};const h=flow.get('event_history')||[];h.push(ev);while(h.length>25000)h.shift();flow.set('event_history',h);flow.set('event_count_total',(flow.get('event_count_total')||0)+1);flow.set('event_last_ts',ev.ts);const d=new Date(Date.now()+10*3600*1000).toISOString().slice(0,10);msg.filename='/data/home/nodered/bsf-archive/events-'+d+'.jsonl';msg.payload=JSON.stringify(ev)+'\n';return msg;

name: daily handler
func: const ev={ts:(msg.payload&&msg.payload.ts)||new Date().toISOString(),topic:msg.topic||'',payload:msg.payload};const h=flow.get('daily_history')||[];h.push(ev);while(h.length>365)h.shift();flow.set('daily_history',h);flow.set('daily_last_ts',ev.ts);const d=new Date(Date.now()+10*3600*1000).toISOString().slice(0,10);msg.filename='/data/home/nodered/bsf-archive/daily-'+d+'.jsonl';msg.payload=JSON.stringify(ev)+'\n';return msg;

name: snapshot builder
func: const now=Date.now();const hw=flow.get('hw_latest');const ac=flow.get('ac_latest');const hwTs=flow.get('hw_latest_ts')||0;const acTs=flow.get('ac_latest_ts')||0;const snap={ts:new Date(now).toISOString(),ts_aest:new Date(now+10*3600*1000).toISOString().slice(0,19).replace('T',' ')+' AEST',hw:hw||null,ac:ac||null,hw_age_s:hwTs?Math.round((now-hwTs)/1000):null,ac_age_s:acTs?Math.round((now-acTs)/1000):null};const r30=flow.get('snapshot_history_30s')||[];r30.push(snap);while(r30.length>5760)r30.shift();flow.set('snapshot_history_30s',r30);const tc=(flow.get('tick_count')||0)+1;flow.set('tick_count',tc);if(tc%10===0){const r5=flow.get('snapshot_history_5min')||[];r5.push(snap);while(r5.length>8640)r5.shift();flow.set('snapshot_history_5min',r5);}flow.set('snapshot_last',snap);const fileMsg={filename:'/data/home/nodered/bsf-archive/state-latest.json',payload:JSON.stringify(snap,null,2)};const mqttMsg={topic:'bsf/_obs/snapshot-retained',payload:snap,retain:true};return [fileMsg,mqttMsg];

name: build state-latest
func: const snap=flow.get('snapshot_last')||null;msg.headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'};msg.payload={ok:true,ts:new Date().toISOString(),snapshot:snap,hw_latest:flow.get('hw_latest')||null,hw_latest_ts:flow.get('hw_latest_ts')||null,ac_latest:flow.get('ac_latest')||null,ac_latest_ts:flow.get('ac_latest_ts')||null};return msg;

name: build events
func: const q=msg.req.query||{};const limit=Math.min(parseInt(q.limit)||100,5000);const since=q.since?Date.parse(q.since):0;const topic=q.topic||null;let h=flow.get('event_history')||[];let out=h;if(since)out=out.filter(e=>Date.parse(e.ts)>=since);if(topic)out=out.filter(e=>e.topic===topic||e.topic.startsWith(topic));out=out.slice(-limit);msg.headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'};msg.payload={ok:true,ts:new Date().toISOString(),count:out.length,total_in_buffer:h.length,events:out};return msg;

name: build daily
func: const q=msg.req.query||{};const days=Math.min(parseInt(q.days)||30,365);const h=flow.get('daily_history')||[];const out=h.slice(-days);msg.headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'};msg.payload={ok:true,ts:new Date().toISOString(),count:out.length,total_in_buffer:h.length,daily:out};return msg;

name: build health
func: const now=Date.now();const hwLatestTs=flow.get('hw_latest_ts')||0;const acLatestTs=flow.get('ac_latest_ts')||0;const evHist=flow.get('event_history')||[];const dHist=flow.get('daily_history')||[];const s30=flow.get('snapshot_history_30s')||[];const s5=flow.get('snapshot_history_5min')||[];msg.headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'};msg.payload={ok:true,ts:new Date().toISOString(),buffers:{snapshot_30s:{count:s30.length,cap:5760,oldest:s30[0]&&s30[0].ts,newest:s30[s30.length-1]&&s30[s30.length-1].ts},snapshot_5min:{count:s5.length,cap:8640,oldest:s5[0]&&s5[0].ts,newest:s5[s5.length-1]&&s5[s5.length-1].ts},events:{count:evHist.length,cap:25000,total_seen:flow.get('event_count_total')||0,last_ts:flow.get('event_last_ts')||null},daily:{count:dHist.length,cap:365,last_ts:flow.get('daily_last_ts')||null}},telemetry_freshness:{hw_latest_age_s:hwLatestTs?Math.round((now-hwLatestTs)/1000):null,ac_latest_age_s:acLatestTs?Math.round((now-acLatestTs)/1000):null},warm_started_from_retained:flow.get('warm_started_from_retained')||null};return msg;
